album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar III

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on E in Avaz. Chaharmezrab (0:28.9) introduces A, Cs, Ab, centred on E. The line peaks at E4 (338.2 Hz) at 0:14.3. It closes on E4, not the tonic (A2 → E4 → A2 → A2 → E4 → E4).
